recent.text: .@Titans LB Cedric Gray said he tried to be a good teammate while waiting his turn to be full-time starter again, like Sunday. Said he was frustrated early on, but let it go. Said his mom and oldest brother have been a good support system, "and my faith has carried me a lot."

recent.text: .@Titans LB Cedric Gray said he's looked at his run after catch on his Sunday interception a few times and felt like he maybe could have scored. "I was just happy to make the play," Gray said, "and get my first career interception."
recent.author: Jim Wyatt

recent.text: .@Titans LB Cedric Gray said he wants to be known for playing fast and physical, and always getting to the football. Gray said it's something he takes pride in, and considers it his "superpower." Gray played WR in high school, and switched to LB. Said he plays with physicality
recent.author: Jim Wyatt
